founded.note: Undated; shown from the century of Igala expansion down the Niger.

summary.text: Ebu, on the west bank of the Niger north of Illah, claims Igala descent and still speaks Igala, the one Igala-speaking kingdom of Anioma. It fought beside its neighbours in the Ekumeku war.

founders.text: Ebu, with Oko Ogbele, Oko Amakom and Oko Anala, claims Igala origin.
